title: Danthron as a novel IL-6R agonist promotes thrombopoiesis via the SRC/RAS/MAPK pathway.
authors: Liao, Rui; Luo, Jiesi; Li, Xiaoxuan; Tang, Xiaoqin; Huang, Miao; Zhou, Ling; Yun, Long; Liu, Zhixuan; Jiang, Peilian; Wang, Xinle; Gan, Xiaolin; Wang, Long; Wu, Jianming
one_liner_zh: 该文研究大黄素通过靶向IL-6R激活SRC/RAS/MAPK通路促进巨核细胞分化与血小板生成，虽涉及分子对接但核心为药物-受体信号通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: This study aimed to investigate the effects of danthron on promoting megakaryocyte (MK) differentiation and alleviating thrombocytopenia, as well as to elucidate its underlying mechanisms. METHODS: Cell proliferation and apoptosis of Meg-01 and K562 cells were evaluated by CCK-8, LDH release, and apoptosis assays. MK differentiation was assessed by Giemsa staining, phalloidin staining, and flow cytometry. A thrombocytopenia mouse model was induced by 4 Gy irradiation and treated intraperitoneally with danthron for 12 days, followed by hematological, histopathological, MK differentiation, and tail bleeding analyses. Potential targets and pathways were explored using network pharmacology, molecular docking, GO/KEGG enrichment, Western blotting, and inhibitor validation. RESULTS: Danthron effectively promoted MK differentiation in vitro, inducing the expression of MK differentiation-related transcription factors NF-E2, RUNX1, MEIS1, and HIF-1beta, without exhibiting significant cytotoxicity. In addition, danthron markedly accelerated the recovery of MK progenitors, MKs, and platelet levels in thrombocytopenic mice, and shortened tail bleeding time. These effects were associated with danthron directly targeting IL-6R and activating the downstream SRC/RAS/MAPK signaling pathway, whereas inhibition of IL-6R or ERK abrogated these effects. CONCLUSION: This study uncovered danthron as a novel natural small-molecule agonist of IL-6R and demonstrated its therapeutic potential in thrombocytopenia. The effect of danthron is mediated by its capacity to promote MK differentiation and induce platelet production through targeting of IL-6R and activation of the downstream SRC/RAS/MAPK signaling pathway. These results highlight danthron as a promising candidate for thrombocytopenia therapy and underscore the therapeutic potential of targeting IL-6R signaling for hematopoietic regulation.
abstract_zh: 背景：本研究旨在探讨丹蒽酮（danthron）促进巨核细胞（MK）分化及缓解血小板减少症的作用，并阐明其潜在机制。方法：通过CCK-8、LDH释放和凋亡实验评估Meg-01和K562细胞的增殖与凋亡。采用Giemsa染色、鬼笔环肽染色和流式细胞术评估MK分化。通过4 Gy照射诱导血小板减少症小鼠模型，并腹腔注射丹蒽酮治疗12天，随后进行血液学、组织病理学、MK分化和尾出血分析。利用网络药理学、分子对接、GO/KEGG富集、Western blotting和抑制剂验证探索潜在靶点和通路。结果：丹蒽酮在体外有效促进MK分化，诱导MK分化相关转录因子NF-E2、RUNX1、MEIS1和HIF-1beta的表达，且未表现出显著细胞毒性。此外，丹蒽酮显著加速血小板减少症小鼠中MK祖细胞、MK和血小板水平的恢复，并缩短尾出血时间。这些效应与丹蒽酮直接靶向IL-6R并激活下游SRC/RAS/MAPK信号通路相关，而抑制IL-6R或ERK则消除这些效应。结论：本研究揭示丹蒽酮为一种新型天然小分子IL-6R激动剂，并证明其在血小板减少症中的治疗潜力。丹蒽酮的作用通过靶向IL-6R并激活下游SRC/RAS/MAPK信号通路促进MK分化和诱导血小板生成来介导。这些结果凸显丹蒽酮作为血小板减少症治疗的有前景候选药物，并强调靶向IL-6R信号通路在造血调控中的治疗潜力。
